from fractions import Fraction as F
import json
def trim(a):
    a=list(a)
    while len(a)>1 and not a[-1]:a.pop()
    return a
def add(a,b):
    out=[F(0)]*max(len(a),len(b))
    for i,x in enumerate(a):out[i]+=x
    for i,x in enumerate(b):out[i]+=x
    return trim(out)
def neg(a):return [-x for x in a]
def mul(a,b):
    out=[F(0)]*(len(a)+len(b)-1)
    for i,x in enumerate(a):
        for j,y in enumerate(b):out[i+j]+=x*y
    return trim(out)
def der(a):return trim([i*x for i,x in enumerate(a)][1:] or [F(0)])
def val(a,r):
    return sum(x*r**i for i,x in enumerate(a))
den=mul(list(map(F,[1,1])),list(map(F,[1,16])))
sq=mul(list(map(F,[1,4])),list(map(F,[1,4])))
gap=add(den,neg(sq))
num=add(mul(der(gap),den),neg(mul(gap,der(den))))
def delta(r):return val(gap,r)/val(den,r)
def dtau(r):return val(num,r)/val(den,r)**2*(-6*r)
p,m1,m2=F(2),F(5),F(17)
rho=m1/m2
minimum=lambda x:m2*x*x-2*m1*x+p
checks={
"initial_energy_normalization":F(5,16)*F(16,5)==1,
"strain_weight_normalization":F(16,5)/4==F(4,5),
"denominator_polynomial":den==list(map(F,[1,17,16])),
"defect_numerator":gap==list(map(F,[0,9])),
"defect_derivative_numerator":num==list(map(F,[9,0,-144])),
"initial_defect":delta(F(1))==F(9,34),
"stationary_peak_value":delta(F(1,4))==F(9,25) and dtau(F(1,4))==0,
"initial_increase":dtau(F(1))>0,
"late_decrease_sample":dtau(F(1,16))<0,
"basic_energy_integral":F(4,5)*(F(1,2)+F(1,8))==F(1,2),
"critical_cost_prefactor":F(81)*F(4,5)**2==F(1296,25),
"frequency_cost_exponent":2*2-2==2,
"Young_conjugates_and_viscosity_power":1/F(4,3)+1/F(4)==1 and -F(3,4)*4==-3,
"quadratic_minimum_sample":minimum(rho)==p-m1*m1/m2==F(9,17),
"sample_cost_cancellation":all(delta(r)**2*(1+r)**2==81*r*r/(1+16*r)**2 for r in [F(1),F(1,4),F(1,16)]),
}
controls={
"missing_symmetric_strain_entry_breaks_budget":F(1,2)*F(4,5)*(F(1,2)+F(1,8))!=F(1,2),
"forget_negative_time_chain_rule_reverses_growth":val(num,F(1))<0 and dtau(F(1))>0,
"omit_parabolic_time_jacobian_gives_wrong_N_power":2*2!=2*2-2,
"omit_squared_defect_changes_cost":delta(F(1))*(1+F(1))**2!=delta(F(1))**2*(1+F(1))**2,
"missing_factor_two_in_quadratic_derivative_fails_minimum":minimum(2*rho)>minimum(rho),
}
assert all(checks.values()) and all(controls.values())
print(json.dumps({"status":"PASS","scope":"Designated exact polynomial, normalization and exponent checks only. No numerical integration or simulation; continuous monotonicity, integral asymptotics and PDE/continuation statements require separate analytic review.","exact_checks":checks,"negative_controls":controls,"exact_outputs":{"denominator":list(map(str,den)),"gap_numerator":list(map(str,gap)),"derivative_numerator":list(map(str,num)),"initial_defect":str(delta(F(1))),"peak_defect":str(delta(F(1,4))),"initial_d_delta_d_tau":str(dtau(F(1))),"late_sample_d_delta_d_tau":str(dtau(F(1,16))),"minimum_sample":str(minimum(rho))},"finite_sample_r":["1","1/4","1/16"],"minimum_sample_inputs":{"P":"2","M1":"5","M2":"17"},"no_numerical_integral_or_simulation":True},indent=2,sort_keys=True))
